jobs.title: Lead Product Designer, Banking
jobs.description: Careers Lead Product Designer, Banking Lead Product Designer, Banking Remote - US About Step Step's mission is to improve the financial future of the next generation. Millions of people use our banking and borrowing products to manage, build, and grow their money. Now that we're part of Beast Industries – the company behind MrBeast – we're poised for a new phase of growth to deliver financial literacy and tools at massive scale. About the Role Step is looking for an experienced product designer who can lead the overall product, design, and UX strategy for our core banking platform. We are a design-focused consumer banking product that works on physical products, digital products, and mobile apps. We're looking for someone to roll up their sleeves, lead design on individual features and make design decisions in a role with plenty of room to grow. The ideal candidate is a passionate designer who is proactive in product ownership, comfortable working closely with cross-functional teams to influence product strategy and rally them around elegant, innovative mobile solutions that delight our customers. In this role, you will: Design high quality interactive experiences across mobile, both iOS and Android, and web Lead projects throughout the entire design process; from creative conception to production and release Collaborate with Product, Engineering and Marketing to help define strategy, and the roadmap to achieve business objectives (growth) Collaborate and give feedback/direction to other designers to continually push the level of quality on the team Evaluate current processes, identify best practices, develop plans to reach goals and implement improvements Utilize and contribute to the Step Design System You might thrive in this role if you have: Significant demonstrated experience with end-to-end (hybrid UX and UI) product design for consumer-facing products The ideal candidate has significant experience leading design for consumer fintech products Thinks in systems, designing solutions that scale across products, adapt to future needs, and create consistency beyond individual features Strong visual design sensibility with the range to move fluidly between systemized UI and more expressive, brand-forward moments A craft-obsessed designer who strives for quality and has an amazing attention to detail The ability to lead design for important projects with experience delegating work and giving direction to other designers Excellent written and verbal communication skills (you should be able to clearly articulate your design decisions and the logic behind them) The ability to think at a high level about product strategy and vision (not just 'how it should look' but 'what we should build') Experience in building and shipping applications or software (mobile/web) Uses AI as a creative and productivity multiplier — able to move faster and explore more ideas without sacrificing craft or judgment Must have a portfolio featuring examples of design work Even better if you have: Experience building and maintaining scalable design systems Ability to translate designs into production-quality code Logistics Location: Remote (US) or San Mateo, CA, with occasional travel for team offsites and key meetings Reports to: Head of Design Education: Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single qualification. Strong candidates rarely check every box, and we'd rather meet you than miss you. How we're different We stand for the side hustlers, the creators, the freelancers, and the investors — people who are not afraid to take on challenges, especially when it comes to their finances. Step is focused on disrupting the banking industry by delivering a differentiated, mobile-first consumer experience, and we operate like the customers we serve: customer obsessed, acting as owners, moving with urgency, and breaking the norm. Step is a wholly owned subsidiary of Beast Industries , the media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson (MrBeast), the most-watched person in the world. Beast Industries spans digital media, consumer products, philanthropy, and new ventures, with an audience reach no consumer company has ever had — and Step is tasked with turning that reach into financial literacy and tools for the next generation at massive scale. With Beast's distribution and brand behind it, Step is positioned to scale significantly over the next 12 months, and joining now means helping shape that trajectory from the inside. Come work with us! Step is a remote-first company building banking for the next generation. We offer competitive compensation and stock options, generous medical, dental, vision, and company-paid life insurance, a 401k plan with Safe Harbor company matching, a flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays, 12 weeks paid parental leave with flexible return to work, and a company-provided technology package. If you're looking to join a fast-growing company with a strong mission and vision that puts people first, we want to meet you! Step is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Step is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need an accommodation, please let us know at people@step.com and we'll work with you to provide appropriate support.
